newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil mark bond authorization refers to old issue.
newsitem.headline: Brazil mark bond authorization refers to old issue.

text.p: The Brazilian Central Bank said authorization published Wednesday for a 1.0 billion mark bond issue referred to an operation carried out at the beginning of the month.

Fernando Antonio Gomes, head of the bank's foreign capital department, told Reuters the issue was formalized and the moneys received Wednesday -- hence the publication of a decree officially authorizing the placement. "The decree refers to the issue at the beginning of the month," Gomes said. "We acted rapidly then to take advantage of attractive market conditions and formalized the deal today."
Brazil's priced its 10-year 1.0 billion mark Eurobond at an impressive 230 basis points over equivalent bunds. The warm reception persuaded the republic to double an original 500 million mark issue.
The decree published Wednesday in the government's Official Journal said the receipts would replace domestic debt with external debt.
The Central Bank says the launch was part of a strategy to establish Brazil in international markets and set benchmarks, as well as improve its risk profile.
